title: Normalized neighbor assist definition (legacy neighbor_assists domain)
description: Contract for one normalized neighbor assist: one stored legacy neighbor_assists entry in positional order. The table carries no stable stored id (the legacy loader indexes positionally), so legacy_id is the 0-based positional index as a string (rule S2); native amounts and display strings are kept verbatim (rule S1). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Positional index of the stored neighbor_assists entry as a decimal string (rule S2): the table has no stable stored id and the legacy loader indexes the array positionally.

kind.description: Classification of the stored neighbor_assists domain: every entry maps to neighbor_assist.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets neighbor_assists).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets neighbor_assists).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

position.description: 0-based position of the entry in the stored neighbor_assists array; entry order is positional and preserved (rule S2).

task.description: Help-task prompt shown to the player, preserved verbatim as display data (rule S1).

action.description: Help-action label shown to the player, preserved verbatim as display data (rule S1).

notification.description: Help completion notice fragment, preserved verbatim as display data (rule S1).

rnd.description: Native stored random-weight value, kept verbatim (rule S1).

reward.description: Native stored help reward of coins/cash/xp amounts, kept verbatim; amounts are literals, not references (rule S1).
